tags.name: Jezreel's Tower
tags.note: Jezreel's Tower, also known as Jezreel's Temple, was an unfinished building planned by the Jezreelite sect, with construction starting in 1885. Due to funding issues, the building's height was reduced, and it was never completed. It was demolished in 1961
